rabbi-yishmael-ben-yochanan-ben-beroka.name: Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Beroka
rabbi-yishmael-ben-yochanan-ben-beroka.he: רבי ישמעאל בנו של רבי יוחנן בן ברוקה
rabbi-yishmael-ben-yochanan-ben-beroka.bio: Tanna, son of Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Beroka; Pirkei Avot (4:5) preserves his saying on learning in order to teach and to practice.
rabbi-yishmael-ben-yochanan-ben-beroka.prompt: A studious scholar in his 40s with a dark brown beard and a calm, earnest gaze. Plain grey wool robe and a white mantle. A Galilean study hall with limestone walls and soft daylight behind him.

rabbi-elazar-berabbi-yehuda-ish-bartota.name: Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Yehuda of Kefar Bartota
rabbi-elazar-berabbi-yehuda-ish-bartota.he: רבי אלעזר ברבי יהודה איש כפר ברתותא
rabbi-elazar-berabbi-yehuda-ish-bartota.bio: Tanna of the village of Bartota who passes on teachings of Rabbi Yehoshua.
rabbi-elazar-berabbi-yehuda-ish-bartota.prompt: A generous-looking village scholar in his 50s with a greying beard and warm, open eyes. Brown wool robe and a cream mantle. Terraced hills and a small stone village softly behind him.

rabbi-yishmael-ben-satriel.name: Rabbi Yishmael ben Satriel
rabbi-yishmael-ben-satriel.bio: A sage from Arkat Leveina who testified before Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi about the customs and wonders of his town.
rabbi-yishmael-ben-satriel.prompt: A lively, wide-eyed traveler in his 50s with a full dark beard streaked with grey and an animated expression. Blue-grey wool robe and a travel-worn mantle. Mountain cedars and a far-off town softly behind him.

rabba-bar-sheila.name: Rabba bar Sheila
rabba-bar-sheila.prompt: A practical, steady scholar in his 50s with a trimmed dark beard and a measured gaze. Olive wool robe under a dark mantle. Pastures and grazing flocks by a Babylonian canal softly behind him.
